info.title: goo observability API
info.description: Current development API. Browser server prefixes paths with /api; direct Go server uses unprefixed paths. Python-only operations override servers. Wire-shape schemas describe encoding, not all domain validation. Semantic constraints, custody and source effects remain authoritative in Go. Unknown input fields are rejected; null and omitted fields can decode and then fail domain validation. No authentication is implemented by this lab; cancellation IDs are local capabilities, not authorization.

x-contract-notes: Direct Go accepts any request Content-Type; application/json is the supported client encoding.
Python reparses/reserializes JSON and enforces Content-Length before Go; fixture byte equality describes direct Go, not browser serialization.
Browser proxy: dashboard plan 16 KiB vs Go 256 KiB; metric discovery 16 KiB vs Go 64 KiB; annotations/deployments 16 KiB vs Go 128 KiB.
Direct operation GET validation uses http.Error text/plain with JSON-looking text; browser re-encodes errors as JSON.
Direct tail early errors omit Cache-Control; proxy early JSON errors include no-store.
Python GET prefix routing can forward unsupported suffixes; these are not supported operations.
Malformed non-JSON upstream HTTP errors now return JSON 502 instead of disconnecting; valid JSON errors preserve status.
No generated handlers, semantic validator replacement, API stability guarantee or new authorization layer is introduced.
